_comment: Operational config for job_search.py and match_scorer.py. Commit this file — it contains no personal data. Edit search_queries, title_filter_terms, and apify_settings for your target role.

apify_settings.note: vc_portfolio_keyword narrows the VC portfolio scraper (leave empty to get all roles). wellfound_roles must use Wellfound URL slug format (e.g. 'product-manager', 'data-engineer').

scorer_settings.note: Set provider to 'anthropic', 'openai', or 'zhipuai'. Model must match the provider (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6 for Anthropic, gpt-4o-mini for OpenAI, glm-4-flash for ZhipuAI).
